verdict.rationale: Drata documents its own Policy Center and a Policies API that supports creating policies and creating and listing policy versions, so policy management and versioning are the product's own capability. The rest of the story has no evidence. Missing for 10: a lawyer-grade template library, an editor, an approval workflow, per-employee policy acceptance tracking, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, policies come from a lawyer-grade template library with an editor, versioning, approvals, and per-employee acceptance tracking

citations.quote: List Policies ... Create Policy ... List Policy Versions ... Create Policy Version
